name: 李宗益
objective:
本課程旨在為學生提供環境工程與國際標準整合管理的實務知識基礎，建立 ISO 環境管理相關標準之核心觀念。透過法規解析與實務演練，讓學生對於廠務環境治理及企業淨零轉型有更詳盡的認知，目標是協助學生掌握環境工程管理實務，使其能與產業發展需求接軌。
This course aims to provide students with a practical foundation in environmental engineering and the management of international standards, establishing core concepts of relevant ISO environmental frameworks. Through regulatory analysis and practical exercises, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of facility environmental governance and corporate net-zero transformation. The goal is to equip students with practical skills in environmental engineering management, enabling them to align with industry sustainability development needs.
